summary: Decompose god function build_parser in cli_ci (STARTER-601)

delivery.outcome: src/koru/cli_ci.py build_parser is a small orchestrator; the run/gates/publish subparser definitions live in module-level builder functions with identical CLI behavior, removing the code2llm God Function finding for STARTER-601.
nonGoals: Behavior, help text or public API changes

architecture.decision: Extract the nested _add_project_to_sub closure and each subparser body into module-level helpers (_add_project_option, _build_run_subparser, _build_gates_subparser, _build_publish_subparser); build_parser constructs the root parser and applies the three builders in a loop.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket-183 commit; it is a pure same-file structure rewrite.

validation.evidence: Existing koru ci CLI tests pass unchanged.
Lint and whitespace checks pass for the rewritten module.
Parser parity was verified against origin/main for all three subcommands (identical Namespaces and --help output).
